name: Fen Mosquito Swarm

items.name: Pyrexic Malaria
items.text:
The victim can't reduce its Sickened condition while it's affected by pyrexic malaria

Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude save

Onset 4 days

Stage 1 Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 and Sickened 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 Unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

items.name: Swarming Bites
items.text: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 1d6 piercing damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save) and is exposed to pyrexic malaria. Creatures that fail the saving throw also take 1d4 bleed.

text: When deadly fen mosquitoes gather in large numbers, they form into lethal swarms capable of draining blood at a truly alarming rate. Fen mosquito swarms are typically encountered only in tropical swamps or bogs, but during humid months in spring or summer they can drift into riverine areas or even through the waterfront reaches of settlements.
